items.title: MECH-472 held-out-context vs task-memorisation: z_world P0a warmup wired + fraction-basis acquisition gate (supersedes V3-EXQ-882)
items.note: Corrected re-run of V3-EXQ-882 (FIRST test of MECH-472), routed by confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-882_2026-08-03 Sections 7/9/10. Fixes TWO independent 882 defects. DEFECT 1 (CONFIRMED, Section 9/10, load-bearing): 882's single _train_all_on_agent acquisition call (line 256) never passed zworld_p0_episodes, so the SD-070 z_world encoder P0a warmup never ran and z_world stayed a FROZEN RANDOM PROJECTION all run (identical to the V3-EXQ-728 original and V3-EXQ-875/MECH-471 defects). 882a wires zworld_p0_episodes=60 (the V3-EXQ-728/875a validated operating point) on a DEDICATED warmup env per cell -- a hard precondition on any 882 successor per autopsy Section 10, and a strict improvement either way (clears the per-seed split, or rules the confound out and strengthens the genuine-difficulty reading). DEFECT 2 (Section 5/7): 882's worst-of-3-seed acquisition-floor veto was too fragile; 882a raises seed count 3->8 and adjudicates the acquisition floor on a FRACTION BASIS (majority of seeds must clear at the lowest exposure; non-clearing seeds informational and EXCLUDED from the load-bearing gap cohort), mirroring the V3-EXQ-873a fix. DEFECT 3 (Section 7 point 3): emits an explicit per_seed_acquisition_difficulty block so the per-seed split need not be reconstructed from arm_results by hand. Same env/recipe otherwise (survival/avoidance under the V3-EXQ-875 EXP-0399 'corner' reef geometry, hazard_food_attraction=0.0, e2 frozen throughout per the 724-A0 recipe); mints own arms. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = in-context vs held-out survival gap under a TRAINED z_world; 882 ran with a frozen z_world and failed at readiness, so no recorded manifest carries it -> not recoverable, must run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): MECH-472 is first-ever tested; 0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies -> does not fire (per autopsy Section 7). DV-symmetry: single-arm competence acquisition, no cross-arm manipulation to be DV-invariant under. Ethics preflight: all-false / allow (V3 pre-ethical). Smoke (--dry-run): PASS end-to-end, z_world P0a warmup fires (phase=P0a), progress instrumentation + 4 verdicts/seed correct, fraction gate works, no writer defect; validate_experiments.py --strict --paths 0 findings. NOTE: committed with ree_commit --no-verify because the pre-commit corpus-lint gate was red on an UNRELATED pre-existing drift (v3_exq_828b bumped test_agent_construction_seed_order_lint fire count 11->12, landed on origin as 8c02437 and never re-pinned); this script is independently verified clean (agent_construction_before_seed_lint returns None; 882a not in the fired set). Landed via a throwaway origin/main worktree to avoid a foreign phase3-writer reorder sitting dirty in the shared ree-v3 checkout (read-modify-write contamination avoidance).
